notes.title: Fantasy Fishing Town 1.1.5 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016484/7575730522a1f13dcb88df65b42647df8cdad4b2.gif[/img]

Fantasy Fishing Town 1.1.5 update is now complete.

Improved [Controller <-> Keyboard+Mouse] switching method.
Even if a controller is connected to the computer, inputting with the keyboard or mouse will automatically switch to [Keyboard+Mouse] controls, and pressing buttons on the controller will smoothly switch to [Controller] controls.

Thank you for enjoying the game.

Have a delightful fishing time today!

notes.title: Fantasy Fishing Town officially released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016484/2a7dd45d33de4e1634bce9c9e52caf27d942272e.png[/img]

[h2]Fantasy Fishing Town has been released![/h2]

[h3]The beginning of a fishing life to catch a legendary fish that makes a wish come true![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42016484/5c14c1ed83896c29f9f818c2dbd45b0e90f56a02.gif[/img]

If you have any questions about the game or want to talk to the developer, please feel free to write it using the Steam Discussion menu!

It's an exciting fishing time starting today! Legendary fish, you're mine. Argh!
